question: The stage square's time at a second setting, pushed before CAP-T15STAGE7-*.json. Same steps as CAP-T15STAGE6 (Scale X and Y 150% on the first tab, the mouse onto the square), with Duration 1.2s on Loop and On Appear; On Scroll has no Duration row, so it is read again as it was; a Loop with Type Ping Pong at 0.4s.

rules.A: ours as built (#451): a Loop runs out twice in the Duration, then stays at its End; On Appear goes from its Start to rest in the Duration; On Scroll from its Start to its End in 1000 ms; a Ping Pong Loop as a Continuous one
rules.B: On Hover's 1.5 times the Duration on Loop and On Appear; a Ping Pong Loop goes out and back

Loop 1.2s.A: out in 1200 ms (fitted D), twice, then at 2.25

Loop Ping Pong 0.4s.A: out (D 400), back to 1 in one frame, out again, then at 2.25
Loop Ping Pong 0.4s.B: out and back on its ease, not in one frame

scoring: a time holds when the fitted D is within 10%; the Ping Pong guess holds on its shape (a one-frame drop or not, where it ends)
